story.title: Remains of Texas WWII soldier and POW return home to North Texas
story.summary: The remains of a Texas soldier who died as a prisoner of war during World War II are returning home Tuesday morning, more than 80 years after his death. FORT WORTH, Texas - The remains of a Texas soldier who died as a prisoner of war during World War II are returning home Tuesday morning, more than 80 years after his death. An Army Honor Guard and family members will escort the remains of U.S. Army Pvt. Carrol J. "Sonny" Arrington from DFW Airport to Biggers Funeral Home in Fort Worth between 6 and 7 a.m. Tuesday. The procession will leave the south end of DFW Airport along State Highway 183 and travel through the Mid-Cities using the express lanes. From there, it will continue through Haltom City and North Richland Hills on the North Loop and main lanes to Azle Avenue before exiting toward the funeral home. Drivers in northern Tarrant County should expect temporary roadway closures…
